title: NoTallGrass
description: Do you dislike Tall Grass being a part of bonemeal? This mod allows you to use bonemeal without generating Tall Grass by left clicking.
body:
I like grass and flowers, but for most builds whenever I use bonemeal, I prefer the short grass over the tall grass unless I'm going for a wild nature look. This gives you the option whether you want tall grass or only short grass. 

Left clicking with bonemeal, bonemeals with only short grass.
Right clicking with bone meal, bonemeals with tall grass (the normal way).
